policy: ENCODER_RERANK_CONTRACT §4: scale = max|v|/127 (1 when max = 0); q = clamp(round_half_away_from_zero(v/scale), -127, 127); dot_query = (Σ u_i·q_i) × scale, f32 accumulate.

edge.note: zero vector: scale 1, all-zero q, dot 0
one-hot: scale 1/127, q 127 at the hot index
negative one-hot: q -127 at the hot index
exact .5 ties on a power-of-two scale: half away from zero
